077/**
078 * Maintains lists of permission grants to users and groups to allow for authorization checks by
079 * {@link AccessController}.
080 * <p>
081 * Access control lists are stored in an "internal" metadata table named {@code _acl_}. Each table's
082 * permission grants are stored as a separate row, keyed by the table name. KeyValues for
083 * permissions assignments are stored in one of the formats:
084 *
085 * <pre>
086 * Key                      Desc
087 * --------                 --------
088 * user                     table level permissions for a user [R=read, W=write]
089 * group                    table level permissions for a group
090 * user,family              column family level permissions for a user
091 * group,family             column family level permissions for a group
092 * user,family,qualifier    column qualifier level permissions for a user
093 * group,family,qualifier   column qualifier level permissions for a group
094 * </pre>
095 * <p>
096 * All values are encoded as byte arrays containing the codes from the
097 * org.apache.hadoop.hbase.security.access.TablePermission.Action enum.
098 * </p>
099 */
100@InterfaceAudience.Private
101public final class PermissionStorage {
102  /** Internal storage table for access control lists */
103  public static final TableName ACL_TABLE_NAME =
104    TableName.valueOf(NamespaceDescriptor.SYSTEM_NAMESPACE_NAME_STR, "acl");
105  public static final byte[] ACL_GLOBAL_NAME = ACL_TABLE_NAME.getName();
106  /** Column family used to store ACL grants */
107  public static final String ACL_LIST_FAMILY_STR = "l";
108  public static final byte[] ACL_LIST_FAMILY = Bytes.toBytes(ACL_LIST_FAMILY_STR);
109  /** KV tag to store per cell access control lists */
110  public static final byte ACL_TAG_TYPE = TagType.ACL_TAG_TYPE;
111
112  public static final char NAMESPACE_PREFIX = '@';
113
114  /**
115   * Delimiter to separate user, column family, and qualifier in _acl_ table info: column keys
116   */
117  public static final char ACL_KEY_DELIMITER = ',';
118
119  private static final Logger LOG = LoggerFactory.getLogger(PermissionStorage.class);
120
121  private PermissionStorage() {
122  }
123
124  private static byte[] toTableEntryName(TableName tableName) {
125    return tableName.getName();
126  }
127
128  private static String getNamespaceFromEntryName(byte[] entryName) {
129    return Bytes.toString(entryName, 1);
130  }
131
132  /**
133   * Return the username for this table entry, and add family/qualifier to the given {@code builder}
134   * if available.
135   */
136  private static String parseTableEntry(Permission.Builder builder, byte[] qual) {
137    byte delimiter = (byte) ACL_KEY_DELIMITER;
138    int idx = ArrayUtils.indexOf(qual, delimiter);
139    // no family/qualifier
140    if (idx < 0) {
141      return Bytes.toString(qual);
142    }
143    int idx2 = ArrayUtils.indexOf(qual, delimiter, idx + 1);
144    if (idx2 < 0) {
145      // no qualifer
146      builder.withFamily(Arrays.copyOfRange(qual, idx + 1, qual.length));
147    } else {
148      builder.withFamily(Arrays.copyOfRange(qual, idx + 1, idx2))
149        .withQualifier(Arrays.copyOfRange(qual, idx2 + 1, qual.length));
150    }
151    return Bytes.toString(qual, 0, idx);
152  }
153
154  private static UserPermission parseUserPermission(byte[] entryName, byte[] qual,
155    byte[] actionCodes) {
156    if (ArrayUtils.isEmpty(actionCodes)) {
157      return null;
158    }
159    String user;
160    Permission.Builder builder;
161    if (isGlobalEntry(entryName)) {
162      builder = Permission.newBuilder();
163      user = Bytes.toString(qual);
164    } else if (isNamespaceEntry(entryName)) {
165      builder = Permission.newBuilder(getNamespaceFromEntryName(entryName));
166      user = Bytes.toString(qual);
167    } else {
168      // table entry
169      builder = Permission.newBuilder(TableName.valueOf(entryName));
170      user = parseTableEntry(builder, qual);
171    }
172    return new UserPermission(user, builder.withActionCodes(actionCodes).build());
173  }
174
175  // mainly used in grant/revoke, where we need to get the exact permission record for a given user
176  private static UserPermission getUserPermission(Table aclTable, UserPermission userPerm)
177    throws IOException {
178    byte[] entryName = userPermissionRowKey(userPerm.getPermission());
179    Get get = new Get(entryName);
180    byte[] qual = userPermissionKey(userPerm);
181    get.addColumn(ACL_LIST_FAMILY, qual);
182    Result result = aclTable.get(get);
183    if (result.isEmpty()) {
184      return null;
185    }
186    byte[] actionCodes = result.getValue(ACL_LIST_FAMILY, qual);
187    return parseUserPermission(entryName, qual, actionCodes);
188  }
189
190  private static byte[] getActionCodes(Permission perm) {
191    Permission.Action[] actions = perm.getActions();
192    byte[] actionCodes = new byte[actions.length];
193    for (int i = 0; i < actionCodes.length; i++) {
194      actionCodes[i] = actions[i].code();
195    }
196    return actionCodes;
197  }
198
199  private static void put(Table aclTable, UserPermission userPerm) throws IOException {
200    Permission perm = userPerm.getPermission();
201    Put put = new Put(userPermissionRowKey(perm));
202    byte[] qual = userPermissionKey(userPerm);
203    byte[] value = getActionCodes(perm);
204    put.addColumn(ACL_LIST_FAMILY, qual, value);
205    if (LOG.isDebugEnabled()) {
206      LOG.debug("Writing permission with rowKey " + Bytes.toString(put.getRow()) + " "
207        + Bytes.toString(qual) + ": " + Bytes.toStringBinary(value));
208    }
209    aclTable.put(put);
210  }
211
212  private static void delete(UserPermission userPerm, Table aclTable) throws IOException {
213    Delete d = new Delete(userPermissionRowKey(userPerm.getPermission()));
214    byte[] qual = userPermissionKey(userPerm);
215    d.addColumns(ACL_LIST_FAMILY, qual);
216    if (LOG.isDebugEnabled()) {
217      LOG.debug("Removing permission with rowKey " + Bytes.toString(d.getRow()) + " "
218        + Bytes.toString(qual));
219    }
220    aclTable.delete(d);
221  }
222
223  private static IOException warnAndThrow(String msg) throws IOException {
224    LOG.warn(msg);
225    throw new IOException(msg);
226  }
227
228  private static void validateUserOrGroupName(String name, Function<String, String> formatter)
229    throws IOException {
230    // empty name is not allowed
231    if (StringUtils.isBlank(name)) {
232      throw warnAndThrow(formatter.apply("Blank %s name '%s' is not allowed"));
233    }
234    // leading/trailing whitespace is not allowed since a real name never has it
235    if (!name.equals(name.trim())) {
236      throw warnAndThrow(
237        formatter.apply("Leading or trailing whitespace in %s name '%s' is not allowed"));
238    }
239    // ',' is used as separator so you can not use it in name
240    if (name.contains(",")) {
241      throw warnAndThrow(formatter.apply("',' in %s name '%s' is not allowed"));
242    }
243  }
244
245  private static void validateUser(String user) throws IOException {
246    if (user == null) {
247      throw warnAndThrow("null user name is not allowed");
248    }
249    if (user.startsWith("@")) {
250      validateUserOrGroupName(user.substring(1), msg -> String.format(msg, "group", user));
251    } else {
252      validateUserOrGroupName(user, msg -> String.format(msg, "user", user));
253    }
254  }
255
256  /**
257   * Stores a new user permission grant in the access control lists table.
258   * @param conn     connection to hbase cluster
259   * @param userPerm the details of the permission to be granted
260   * @param aclTable acl table instance. It is closed upon method return.
261   * @throws IOException in the case of an error accessing the metadata table, or the
262   *                     {@code userPerm} is invalid, i.e, has an invalid user/group name or an
263   *                     empty actions.
264   */
265  public static void addUserPermission(Connection conn, UserPermission userPerm,
266    boolean mergeExistingPermissions) throws IOException {
267    validateUser(userPerm.getUser());
268    if (ArrayUtils.isEmpty(userPerm.getPermission().getActions())) {
269      throw warnAndThrow("No actions associated with user '" + userPerm.getUser() + "'");
270    }
271    try (Table aclTable = conn.getTable(ACL_TABLE_NAME)) {
272      UserPermission toAdd;
273      if (mergeExistingPermissions) {
274        UserPermission oldUserPerm = getUserPermission(aclTable, userPerm);
275        if (oldUserPerm == null || ArrayUtils.isEmpty(oldUserPerm.getPermission().getActions())) {
276          toAdd = userPerm;
277        } else {
278          Set<Permission.Action> actionSet = new TreeSet<>();
279          actionSet.addAll(Arrays.asList(oldUserPerm.getPermission().getActions()));
280          actionSet.addAll(Arrays.asList(userPerm.getPermission().getActions()));
281          oldUserPerm.getPermission().setActions(actionSet.toArray(Permission.Action[]::new));
282          toAdd = oldUserPerm;
283        }
284      } else {
285        toAdd = userPerm;
286      }
287      put(aclTable, toAdd);
288    }
289  }
290
291  /**
292   * Removes a previously granted permission from the stored access control lists.
293   * <p>
294   * The {@link TablePermission} being removed must exactly match what is stored -- no wildcard
295   * matching is attempted. Ie, if user "bob" has been granted "READ" access to the "data" table,
296   * but only to column family plus qualifier "info:colA", then trying to call this method with only
297   * user "bob" and the table name "data" (but without specifying the column qualifier "info:colA")
298   * will have no effect.
299   * <p>
300   * Passing an {@code userPerm} with empty actions means revoke all the permissions.
301   * @param conn     connection to hbase cluster
302   * @param userPerm the details of the permission to be revoked
303   * @throws IOException in the case of an error accessing the metadata table, or the
304   *                     {@code userPerm} is invalid, i.e, has an invalid user/group name.
305   */
306  public static void removeUserPermission(Connection conn, UserPermission userPerm)
307    throws IOException {
308    validateUser(userPerm.getUser());
309    try (Table aclTable = conn.getTable(ACL_TABLE_NAME)) {
310      Permission perm = userPerm.getPermission();
311      if (ArrayUtils.isEmpty(perm.getActions())) {
312        delete(userPerm, aclTable);
313        return;
314      }
315      UserPermission oldUserPerm = getUserPermission(aclTable, userPerm);
316      if (oldUserPerm == null) {
317        // nothing to revoke
318        return;
319      }
320      Permission oldPerm = oldUserPerm.getPermission();
321      Set<Permission.Action> remainingActions = new TreeSet<>();
322      if (!ArrayUtils.isEmpty(oldPerm.getActions())) {
323        remainingActions.addAll(Arrays.asList(oldPerm.getActions()));
324      }
325      for (Permission.Action action : perm.getActions()) {
326        remainingActions.remove(action);
327      }
328      if (remainingActions.isEmpty()) {
329        delete(userPerm, aclTable);
330      } else {
331        oldPerm.setActions(remainingActions.toArray(Permission.Action[]::new));
332        put(aclTable, oldUserPerm);
333      }
334      if (LOG.isDebugEnabled()) {
335        LOG.debug("Removed permission " + userPerm.toString());
336      }
337    }
338  }

340  /**
341   * Remove specified table from the _acl_ table.
342   */
343  static void removeTablePermissions(Connection conn, TableName tableName) throws IOException {
344    if (LOG.isDebugEnabled()) {
345      LOG.debug("Removing permissions of removed table " + tableName);
346    }
347    Delete d = new Delete(toTableEntryName(tableName)).addFamily(ACL_LIST_FAMILY);
348    try (Table aclTable = conn.getTable(ACL_TABLE_NAME)) {
349      aclTable.delete(d);
350    }
351  }

367  /**
368   * Remove permissions of the specified column families of the given table from the acl table.
369   */
370  static void removeTableColumnFamiliesPermissions(Connection conn, TableName tableName,
371    Collection<byte[]> columns) throws IOException {
372    if (LOG.isDebugEnabled()) {
373      LOG.debug("Removing permissions of removed columns {} from table {}",
374        columns.stream().map(Bytes::toStringBinary).collect(Collectors.joining(", ")), tableName);
375    }
376    Set<byte[]> families = new TreeSet<>(Bytes.BYTES_COMPARATOR);
377    families.addAll(columns);
378    List<UserPermission> userPerms = getTablePermissions(conn, tableName);
379    Delete d = new Delete(toTableEntryName(tableName));
380    boolean found = false;
381    for (UserPermission userPerm : userPerms) {
382      TablePermission perm = (TablePermission) userPerm.getPermission();
383      byte[] family = perm.getFamily();
384      if (family != null && families.contains(family)) {
385        d.addColumns(ACL_LIST_FAMILY, userPermissionKey(userPerm));
386        found = true;
387      }
388    }
389    if (found) {
390      try (Table aclTable = conn.getTable(ACL_TABLE_NAME)) {
391        aclTable.delete(d);
392      }
393    }
394  }
395
396  private static byte[] userPermissionRowKey(Permission permission) {
397    byte[] row;
398    if (permission instanceof TablePermission) {
399      TablePermission tablePerm = (TablePermission) permission;
400      row = toTableEntryName(tablePerm.getTableName());
401    } else if (permission instanceof NamespacePermission) {
402      NamespacePermission nsPerm = (NamespacePermission) permission;
403      row = toNamespaceEntry(nsPerm.getNamespace());
404    } else {
405      // permission instanceof TablePermission
406      row = ACL_GLOBAL_NAME;
407    }
408    return row;
409  }
410
411  /**
412   * Build qualifier key from user permission: username username,family username,family,qualifier
413   */
414  private static byte[] userPermissionKey(UserPermission permission) {
415    byte[] key = Bytes.toBytes(permission.getUser());
416    byte[] qualifier = null;
417    byte[] family = null;
418    if (permission.getPermission().getAccessScope() == Permission.Scope.TABLE) {
419      TablePermission tablePermission = (TablePermission) permission.getPermission();
420      family = tablePermission.getFamily();
421      qualifier = tablePermission.getQualifier();
422    }
423
424    if (family != null && family.length > 0) {
425      key = Bytes.add(key, Bytes.add(new byte[] { ACL_KEY_DELIMITER }, family));
426      if (qualifier != null && qualifier.length > 0) {
427        key = Bytes.add(key, Bytes.add(new byte[] { ACL_KEY_DELIMITER }, qualifier));
428      }
429    }
430
431    return key;
432  }

434  /**
435   * Returns {@code true} if the given region is part of the {@code _acl_} metadata table.
436   */
437  static boolean isAclRegion(Region region) {
438    return ACL_TABLE_NAME.equals(region.getTableDescriptor().getTableName());
439  }

441  /**
442   * Returns {@code true} if the given table is {@code _acl_} metadata table.
443   */
444  static boolean isAclTable(TableDescriptor desc) {
445    return ACL_TABLE_NAME.equals(desc.getTableName());
446  }

448  /**
449   * Loads all of the permission grants stored in a region of the {@code _acl_} table.
450   * @param aclRegion the acl region
451   * @return a map of the permissions for this table.
452   * @throws IOException if an error occurs
453   */
454  static Map<byte[], ListMultimap<String, UserPermission>> loadAll(Region aclRegion)
455    throws IOException {
456    if (!isAclRegion(aclRegion)) {
457      throw new IOException("Can only load permissions from " + ACL_TABLE_NAME);
458    }
459
460    Map<byte[], ListMultimap<String, UserPermission>> allPerms =
461      new TreeMap<>(Bytes.BYTES_RAWCOMPARATOR);
462    // do a full scan of _acl_ table
463    Scan scan = new Scan().addFamily(ACL_LIST_FAMILY);
464    try (InternalScanner scanner = aclRegion.getScanner(scan);) {
465      while (true) {
466        List<Cell> row = new ArrayList<>();
467        boolean hasNext = scanner.next(row);
468        ListMultimap<String, UserPermission> perms = ArrayListMultimap.create();
469        byte[] entry = null;
470        for (Cell kv : row) {
471          if (entry == null) {
472            entry = CellUtil.cloneRow(kv);
473          }
474          UserPermission userPerm =
475            parseUserPermission(entry, CellUtil.cloneQualifier(kv), CellUtil.cloneValue(kv));
476          if (userPerm != null) {
477            perms.put(userPerm.getUser(), userPerm);
478          }
479        }
480        if (entry != null) {
481          allPerms.put(entry, perms);
482        }
483        if (!hasNext) {
484          break;
485        }
486      }
487    }
488
489    return allPerms;
490  }
491
492  /**
493   * Load all permissions from the region server holding {@code _acl_}, primarily intended for
494   * testing purposes.
495   */
496  @RestrictedApi(explanation = "Should only be called in tests", link = "",
497      allowedOnPath = ".*/src/test/.*")
498  static Map<byte[], ListMultimap<String, UserPermission>> loadAll(Connection conn)
499    throws IOException {
500    Map<byte[], ListMultimap<String, UserPermission>> allPerms =
501      new TreeMap<>(Bytes.BYTES_RAWCOMPARATOR);
502
503    // do a full scan of _acl_, filtering on only first table region rows
504    Scan scan = new Scan();
505    scan.addFamily(ACL_LIST_FAMILY);
506    try (Table table = conn.getTable(ACL_TABLE_NAME);
507      ResultScanner scanner = table.getScanner(scan)) {
508      while (true) {
509        Result result = scanner.next();
510        if (result == null) {
511          break;
512        }
513        byte[] entryName = result.getRow();
514        ListMultimap<String, UserPermission> perms = ArrayListMultimap.create();
515        result.getFamilyMap(ACL_LIST_FAMILY).forEach((qual, actionCodes) -> {
516          UserPermission userPerm = parseUserPermission(entryName, qual, actionCodes);
517          if (userPerm != null) {
518            perms.put(userPerm.getUser(), userPerm);
519          } else {
520            // Malformed/empty ACL cell; skip to avoid NPE and continue scanning.
521            LOG.warn("Skipping malformed ACL entry for row={} qualifier={}",
522              Bytes.toStringBinary(entryName), Bytes.toStringBinary(qual));
523          }
524        });
525        allPerms.put(entryName, perms);
526      }
527    }
528
529    return allPerms;
530  }
531
532  /**
533   * Get all the permission entries for this table.
534   */
535  public static List<UserPermission> getTablePermissions(Connection conn, TableName tableName)
536    throws IOException {
537    if (ACL_TABLE_NAME.equals(tableName)) {
538      // hbase:acl does not have any permission record, the entry for hbase:acl is for storing the
539      // global permissions
540      // TODO: typically caller should not do this, better throwing an exception?
541      return getGlobalPermissions(conn);
542    }
543    byte[] entryName = toTableEntryName(tableName);
544    Get get = new Get(entryName).addFamily(ACL_LIST_FAMILY);
545    List<UserPermission> userPerms = new ArrayList<>();
546    try (Table aclTable = conn.getTable(ACL_TABLE_NAME)) {
547      Result result = aclTable.get(get);
548      if (!result.isEmpty()) {
549        result.getFamilyMap(ACL_LIST_FAMILY).forEach((qual, actionCodes) -> {
550          if (ArrayUtils.isEmpty(actionCodes)) {
551            // Malformed/empty ACL cell; skip to avoid NPE
552            LOG.warn("Skipping malformed ACL entry for row={} qualifier={}",
553              Bytes.toStringBinary(entryName), Bytes.toStringBinary(qual));
554            return;
555          }
556          Permission.Builder builder =
557            Permission.newBuilder(tableName).withActionCodes(actionCodes);
558          String user = parseTableEntry(builder, qual);
559          userPerms.add(new UserPermission(user, builder.build()));
560        });
561      }
562    }
563    return userPerms;
564  }
565
566  public static List<UserPermission> getNamespacePermissions(Connection conn, String namespace)
567    throws IOException {
568    byte[] entryName = toNamespaceEntry(namespace);
569    Get get = new Get(entryName).addFamily(ACL_LIST_FAMILY);
570    List<UserPermission> userPerms = new ArrayList<>();
571    try (Table aclTable = conn.getTable(ACL_TABLE_NAME)) {
572      Result result = aclTable.get(get);
573      if (!result.isEmpty()) {
574
575        result.getFamilyMap(ACL_LIST_FAMILY).forEach((qual, actionCodes) -> {
576          if (ArrayUtils.isEmpty(actionCodes)) {
577            // Malformed/empty ACL cell; skip to avoid NPE
578            LOG.warn("Skipping malformed ACL entry for row={} qualifier={}",
579              Bytes.toStringBinary(entryName), Bytes.toStringBinary(qual));
580            return;
581          }
582          Permission perm = Permission.newBuilder(namespace).withActionCodes(actionCodes).build();
583          String user = Bytes.toString(qual);
584          userPerms.add(new UserPermission(user, perm));
585        });
586      }
587    }
588    return userPerms;
589  }

591  public static List<UserPermission> getGlobalPermissions(Connection conn) throws IOException {
592    Get get = new Get(ACL_GLOBAL_NAME).addFamily(ACL_LIST_FAMILY);
593    List<UserPermission> userPerms = new ArrayList<>();
594    try (Table aclTable = conn.getTable(ACL_TABLE_NAME)) {
595      Result result = aclTable.get(get);
596      if (!result.isEmpty()) {
597        result.getFamilyMap(ACL_LIST_FAMILY).forEach((qual, actionCodes) -> {
598          if (ArrayUtils.isEmpty(actionCodes)) {
599            // Malformed/empty ACL cell; skip to avoid NPE
600            LOG.warn("Skipping malformed ACL entry for row={} qualifier={}",
601              Bytes.toStringBinary(ACL_GLOBAL_NAME), Bytes.toStringBinary(qual));
602            return;
603          }
604          Permission perm = Permission.newBuilder().withActionCodes(actionCodes).build();
605          String user = Bytes.toString(qual);
606          userPerms.add(new UserPermission(user, perm));
607        });
608      }
609    }
610    return userPerms;
611  }

613  public static boolean isGlobalEntry(byte[] entryName) {
614    return Bytes.equals(entryName, ACL_GLOBAL_NAME);
615  }

617  public static boolean isNamespaceEntry(String entryName) {
618    return isNamespaceEntry(Bytes.toBytes(entryName));
619  }
620
621  public static boolean isNamespaceEntry(byte[] entryName) {
622    return entryName != null && entryName.length != 0 && entryName[0] == NAMESPACE_PREFIX;
623  }
624
625  public static boolean isTableEntry(byte[] entryName) {
626    return !isNamespaceEntry(entryName) && !isGlobalEntry(entryName) && entryName != null;
627  }
628
629  public static byte[] toNamespaceEntry(String namespace) {
630    return Bytes.toBytes(NAMESPACE_PREFIX + namespace);
631  }
632
633  public static String fromNamespaceEntry(String namespace) {
634    if (namespace.charAt(0) != NAMESPACE_PREFIX) {
635      throw new IllegalArgumentException("Argument is not a valid namespace entry");
636    }
637    return namespace.substring(1);
638  }
639
640  public static byte[] toNamespaceEntry(byte[] namespace) {
641    byte[] ret = new byte[namespace.length + 1];
642    ret[0] = NAMESPACE_PREFIX;
643    System.arraycopy(namespace, 0, ret, 1, namespace.length);
644    return ret;
645  }
646
647  public static byte[] fromNamespaceEntry(byte[] namespace) {
648    if (namespace[0] != NAMESPACE_PREFIX) {
649      throw new IllegalArgumentException(
650        "Argument is not a valid namespace entry: " + Bytes.toString(namespace));
651    }
652    return Arrays.copyOfRange(namespace, 1, namespace.length);
653  }
654
655  public static List<Permission> getCellPermissionsForUser(User user, ExtendedCell cell)
656    throws IOException {
657    // Save an object allocation where we can
658    if (cell.getTagsLength() == 0) {
659      return null;
660    }
661    List<Permission> results = Lists.newArrayList();
662    Iterator<Tag> tagsIterator = PrivateCellUtil.tagsIterator(cell);
663    while (tagsIterator.hasNext()) {
664      Tag tag = tagsIterator.next();
665      if (tag.getType() == ACL_TAG_TYPE) {
666        // Deserialize the table permissions from the KV
667        // TODO: This can be improved. Don't build UsersAndPermissions just to unpack it again,
668        // use the builder
669        AccessControlProtos.UsersAndPermissions.Builder builder =
670          AccessControlProtos.UsersAndPermissions.newBuilder();
671        if (tag.hasArray()) {
672          ProtobufUtil.mergeFrom(builder, tag.getValueArray(), tag.getValueOffset(),
673            tag.getValueLength());
674        } else {
675          ProtobufUtil.mergeFrom(builder, Tag.cloneValue(tag));
676        }
677        ListMultimap<String, Permission> kvPerms =
678          AccessControlUtil.toUsersAndPermissions(builder.build());
679        // Are there permissions for this user?
680        List<Permission> userPerms = kvPerms.get(user.getShortName());
681        if (userPerms != null) {
682          results.addAll(userPerms);
683        }
684        // Are there permissions for any of the groups this user belongs to?
685        String[] groupNames = user.getGroupNames();
686        if (groupNames != null) {
687          for (String group : groupNames) {
688            List<Permission> groupPerms = kvPerms.get(AuthUtil.toGroupEntry(group));
689            if (results != null) {
690              results.addAll(groupPerms);
691            }
692          }
693        }
694      }
695    }
696    return results;
697  }

699  // ====================
700  // Below are methods for sync permission between acl table and zk
701  // ====================
702
703  /**
704   * Reads user permission assignments stored in the <code>l:</code> column family of the first
705   * table row in <code>_acl_</code>.
706   * <p>
707   * See {@link PermissionStorage class documentation} for the key structure used for storage.
708   * </p>
709   */
710  static ListMultimap<String, UserPermission> getPermissions(Connection conn, byte[] entryName)
711    throws IOException {
712    // for normal user tables, we just read the table row from _acl_
713    ListMultimap<String, UserPermission> perms = ArrayListMultimap.create();
714    Get get = new Get(entryName);
715    get.addFamily(ACL_LIST_FAMILY);
716    Result result;
717    try (Table aclTable = conn.getTable(ACL_TABLE_NAME)) {
718      result = aclTable.get(get);
719    }
720    if (!result.isEmpty()) {
721      result.getFamilyMap(ACL_LIST_FAMILY).forEach((qual, actionCodes) -> {
722        UserPermission userPerm = parseUserPermission(entryName, qual, actionCodes);
723        if (userPerm != null) {
724          perms.put(userPerm.getUser(), userPerm);
725        } else {
726          // Malformed/empty ACL cell; skip to avoid NPE
727          LOG.warn("Skipping malformed ACL entry for row={} qualifier={}",
728            Bytes.toStringBinary(entryName), Bytes.toStringBinary(qual));
729        }
730      });
731    } else {
732      LOG.info("No permissions found in " + ACL_TABLE_NAME + " for acl entry "
733        + Bytes.toString(entryName));
734    }
735
736    return perms;
737  }
738
739  /**
740   * Writes a set of permissions as {@link org.apache.hadoop.io.Writable} instances and returns the
741   * resulting byte array. Writes a set of permission [user: table permission]
742   */
743  public static byte[] writePermissionsAsBytes(ListMultimap<String, UserPermission> perms,
744    Configuration conf) {
745    return ProtobufUtil
746      .prependPBMagic(AccessControlUtil.toUserTablePermissions(perms).toByteArray());
747  }
748
749  // This is part of the old HbaseObjectWritableFor96Migration.
750  private static final int LIST_CODE = 61;
751
752  private static final int WRITABLE_CODE = 14;
753
754  private static final int WRITABLE_NOT_ENCODED = 0;
755
756  private static List<Permission> readWritableUserPermission(DataInput in, Configuration conf)
757    throws IOException, ClassNotFoundException {
758    assert WritableUtils.readVInt(in) == LIST_CODE;
759    int length = in.readInt();
760    List<Permission> list = new ArrayList<>(length);
761    for (int i = 0; i < length; i++) {
762      assert WritableUtils.readVInt(in) == WRITABLE_CODE;
763      assert WritableUtils.readVInt(in) == WRITABLE_NOT_ENCODED;
764      String className = Text.readString(in);
765      Class<? extends Writable> clazz = conf.getClassByName(className).asSubclass(Writable.class);
766      Writable instance = WritableFactories.newInstance(clazz, conf);
767      instance.readFields(in);
768      list.add((Permission) instance);
769    }
770    return list;
771  }
772
773  public static ListMultimap<String, UserPermission> readUserPermission(byte[] data,
774    Configuration conf) throws DeserializationException {
775    if (ProtobufUtil.isPBMagicPrefix(data)) {
776      int pblen = ProtobufUtil.lengthOfPBMagic();
777      try {
778        AccessControlProtos.UsersAndPermissions.Builder builder =
779          AccessControlProtos.UsersAndPermissions.newBuilder();
780        ProtobufUtil.mergeFrom(builder, data, pblen, data.length - pblen);
781        return AccessControlUtil.toUserPermission(builder.build());
782      } catch (IOException e) {
783        throw new DeserializationException(e);
784      }
785    } else {
786      // TODO: We have to re-write non-PB data as PB encoded. Otherwise we will carry old Writables
787      // forever (here and a couple of other places).
788      ListMultimap<String, UserPermission> userPermission = ArrayListMultimap.create();
789      try {
790        DataInput in = new DataInputStream(new ByteArrayInputStream(data));
791        int length = in.readInt();
792        for (int i = 0; i < length; i++) {
793          String user = Text.readString(in);
794          List<Permission> perms = readWritableUserPermission(in, conf);
795          for (Permission p : perms) {
796            userPermission.put(user, new UserPermission(user, p));
797          }
798        }
799      } catch (IOException | ClassNotFoundException e) {
800        throw new DeserializationException(e);
801      }
802      return userPermission;
803    }
804  }
805
806  public static ListMultimap<String, Permission> readPermissions(byte[] data, Configuration conf)
807    throws DeserializationException {
808    if (ProtobufUtil.isPBMagicPrefix(data)) {
809      int pblen = ProtobufUtil.lengthOfPBMagic();
810      try {
811        AccessControlProtos.UsersAndPermissions.Builder builder =
812          AccessControlProtos.UsersAndPermissions.newBuilder();
813        ProtobufUtil.mergeFrom(builder, data, pblen, data.length - pblen);
814        return AccessControlUtil.toPermission(builder.build());
815      } catch (IOException e) {
816        throw new DeserializationException(e);
817      }
818    } else {
819      // TODO: We have to re-write non-PB data as PB encoded. Otherwise we will carry old Writables
820      // forever (here and a couple of other places).
821      ListMultimap<String, Permission> perms = ArrayListMultimap.create();
822      try {
823        DataInput in = new DataInputStream(new ByteArrayInputStream(data));
824        int length = in.readInt();
825        for (int i = 0; i < length; i++) {
826          String user = Text.readString(in);
827          perms.putAll(user, readWritableUserPermission(in, conf));
828        }
829      } catch (IOException | ClassNotFoundException e) {
830        throw new DeserializationException(e);
831      }
832      return perms;
833    }
834  }
